# Aberos PLC | Shopping Mall, Restaurant & Flooring Factory Company
> A diversified company operating a shopping mall, restaurant, and floor factory, delivering quality retail, dining, and manufacturing solutions.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://aberosplc.netlify.app): Introduction, statistics and overviews.
- [About](https://aberosplc.netlify.app/about): About Aberos and it's mission and vission.
- [Projects](https://aberosplc.netlify.app/companies): detail about each sub companies.
- [Contact](https://aberosplc.netlify.app/contact): Contact and collaboration information.
